subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: why dont you attend classes regularly the teacher said to the student you cant expect good results unless you attend classes as i tell you i am sorry sir i have offended you said the student Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: "Why don't you attend classes regularly?" the teacher said to the student. "You can't expect good results unless you attend classes as I tell you." "I am sorry, sir. I have offended you," said the student. ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
